title: Bootstrap package of a test station
description: Issued by 'layer provision ID' of the test layer; replaces the factory step and the first start of a real device. Harness only: production devices have no such package.

address.description: host:port of the test layer's broker

ca.description: PEM root of the test layer, pinned by the station

cert.description: PEM device certificate under the test layer CA, OU bench

key.description: PEM software key of the device (a real device keeps it in its secure element)

chain.description: PEM SECC certificate under the test V2G root, shown to the EV; its key stays in the test layer
